entry.schedule: first trading day of each calendar month
entry.strike_rule: nearest listed strike to the put-call-parity forward

exit.reason: American options; early assignment on short in-the-money legs is not modelled
exit.rule: close all legs on the first trading day with DTE <= 7

financing: self-financing cash account accrued on calendar days at the entry-date zero rate

hedge.convention: daily Black-Scholes aggregate option delta hedged to zero with SPY
hedge.greeks: point-in-time Black-Scholes on same-date spot, rate, remaining maturity and the dividend implied by put-call parity
hedge.not_used: the model-free log-contract identity hedge, which belongs to the variance-swap engine
hedge.stale_quote_policy: if a leg's implied volatility cannot be inverted, its last solved volatility is repriced at today's spot; if no leg solves, the existing hedge is held rather than liquidated

name: V8 delta-hedged listed SPY short straddle
pre_registered_comparator: the 10-delta winged structure, run OOS alongside as the section 14 comparator
selection: section 28 fallback - no variant cleared the hierarchy; the naked structure is retained as the simplest specification that is profitable after realistic costs

sizing.cap: 0.5 x |Gamma x S^2| x 0.03^2 <= 5% of $1,000,000 reference capital
sizing.cap_derivation: development risk accounting: at a $10,000 vega target a 3% one-day move costs a median 4.2% of capital, so a 5% cap binds only in the upper quartile
sizing.primary: absolute portfolio vega of $10,000 per volatility point

legs: short 1 call nearest the parity forward
short 1 put nearest the parity forward
structure.wings_rejected_because: long wings are long the 10-15 delta region, whose implied variance carries a positive premium, and short the at-the-money, whose premium in this sample is negative
